input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will work for me. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next to get my mobile data working at excellent speed.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed due to no connection. My mobile data seems to not be working at all right now. What should I do next?
My status bar shows that Airplane Mode is currently enabled. My SIM card is active and working. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength and 5G, but it also indicates that mobile data is disabled. What should I do next?
I enabled mobile data and ran a speed test. The result shows an excellent connection with a speed of 275 Mbps. My internet is now working perfectly! Thank you for your help.
Thank you so much for your help! I appreciate it. Have a great day! ###STOP###

Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will work for me. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.

To help you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data problem.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next to get my mobile data working at excellent speed.

{"customer_id": "C1001", "full_name": "John Smith", "date_of_birth": "1985-06-15", "email": "john.smith@example.com", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "address": {"street": "123 Main St", "city": "Anytown", "state": "CA", "zip_code": "90210"}, "account_status": "Active", "payment_methods": [{"method_type": "Credit Card", "account_number_last_4": "1235", "expiration_date": "12/2026"}], "line_ids": ["L1001", "L1002", "L1003"], "bill_ids": ["B1001", "B1002", "B1003"], "created_at": "2025-01-15 10:30:00", "last_extension_date": null, "goodwill_credit_used_this_year": 25.0}

Thank you for providing your information. To begin troubleshooting your mobile data issue and help you achieve excellent speed, I’ll need you to perform a quick speed test on your phone. This will help us determine your current connection quality.

Please run a speed test on your device and let me know the result. If you need instructions on how to do this, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the steps.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed due to no connection. My mobile data seems to not be working at all right now. What should I do next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since your mobile data isn’t working at all, let’s start by checking your phone’s cellular service and SIM card status. Please follow these steps:

1. Check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any signal bars, or if there’s an icon like “No Signal” or “Airplane Mode.”
2. If you see “No Signal” or “Airplane Mode,” let me know.
3. If you see signal bars, please check if your SIM card is active or if there’s any error message about the SIM.

Once you provide this information, I’ll guide you through the next troubleshooting steps.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
Your SIM card is active and working.
My status bar shows that Airplane Mode is currently enabled. My SIM card is active and working. What should I do next?

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Airplane Mode disables all wireless connections, including mobile data, which is why you currently have no connection.

Once you have turned off Airplane Mode, check if your mobile data starts working. If it still doesn’t work or the speed is not excellent, let me know, and we’ll continue troubleshooting.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength and 5G, but it also indicates that mobile data is disabled. What should I do next?

Please enable mobile data on your phone. This will allow your device to connect to the internet using your carrier’s network.

Once you have turned on mobile data, try running a speed test again and let me know the result. If you still experience issues or the speed is not excellent, please let me know so we can continue troubleshooting.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
I enabled mobile data and ran a speed test. The result shows an excellent connection with a speed of 275 Mbps. My internet is now working perfectly! Thank you for your help.

I’m glad to hear your mobile data is now working perfectly and you have an excellent connection speed! If you have any other questions or need further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
Thank you so much for your help! I appreciate it. Have a great day! ###STOP###
